description.value: Funded to reach the only catalogued world in the outward sector and to establish whether its fracture chemistry means anything. It did not arrive. A drive fault at the third waypoint left the ship on a return leg that could not be shortened, and the expedition spent four of its six years travelling in the wrong direction with the instruments running. No report was filed, on the ground that there was nothing to report on. The instrument record was deposited anyway and later settled a question about the outward margin entirely by accident.

notes.value: The finance office continues to list the expedition as delivered, on the ground that the ship came back.
